verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a web API product, so versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions to ask. The evidence documents neither versioned API endpoints nor a formal deprecation policy. The only deprecation-related item is a notice that the legacy google-search-results-python client library will be deprecated in favor of serpapi-python. That is an adjacent SDK migration notice, not API versioning or a documented deprecation policy, so it earns no credit.
